# Northeast Basecamp

Northeast Basecamp provides festival stay requests and travel support for Hornbill Festival in Nagaland and Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival in Meghalaya.

## Current festival stays

- Hornbill Festival, Kisama, Nagaland: secure stay requests are available at https://northeastbasecamp.com/festival-booking.html?festival=hornbill
- Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival, Meghalaya: secure stay requests are available at https://northeastbasecamp.com/festival-booking.html?festival=cherry-blossom
- Festival tickets are not included unless a written confirmation says otherwise.

## Booking and payment

The booking flow collects guest details, creates a payment reference in Northeast Basecamp's database, and transfers the guest to PayU Hosted Checkout. Payment status is verified server-side before it is confirmed. For availability, stay inclusions or help before payment, contact Northeast Basecamp on WhatsApp at +91 87199 62147.

## Stay standards

Northeast Basecamp focuses on comfortable tent stays, clean bedding, clean concrete toilets with three scheduled cleanings daily, guest check-in support, community zones, local culture immersion and practical festival travel guidance. Exact tent category, location, transportation, food and other inclusions are confirmed in writing for every stay.

## Festival information

- Hornbill Festival is held at Naga Heritage Village, Kisama, Nagaland. Check official Hornbill Festival channels for final dates, entry and programme information.
- Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival takes place in Shillong, Meghalaya. Check official festival channels for final dates, entry and programme information.
- Northeast Basecamp is not the organiser of either festival.
